sahneler.metin: A weather satellite being built for NOAA fell over in the factory.
It crashed to the floor and was badly damaged.
Workers were rotating it on a turnover cart.
The bolts that held it to the cart were missing.
Another team had removed them and not recorded it.
The step to check them was skipped.
The satellite was rebuilt and launched years later.
Handling procedures for spacecraft were reinforced.

aciklama:
NOAA-N Prime fell off its stand during manufacturing. The cause: a turnover cart missing its bolts because procedures weren't followed.

#shorts #engineering #industrial

vaka.mekanizma: a turnover cart missing its bolts because procedures weren't followed
vaka.ders: NASA reinforced procedure checks for handling spacecraft
vaka.yanilgi: The satellite wasn't dropped by a crane. It slid off a cart whose bolts had been removed by another team.
vaka.tartisma: The step to verify the bolts was skipped because it seemed routine. Why do routine checks get skipped?
